samples: This tool reads a text file, counts case-insensitive words separated by spaces, and prints the ten most frequent words with their counts. If no command-line file path is provided, it reads `data/sample.txt`. Use it for simple word-frequency summaries; it does not handle punctuation or more advanced tokenization.

This program reads a text file, counts case-insensitive words separated by spaces, and prints the ten most frequent words with their occurrence counts. If no command-line path is provided, it reads `data/sample.txt`. It is useful for a simple word-frequency summary, but it does not handle punctuation or more advanced tokenization.

This program reads a text file, counts lower-cased words separated by spaces, and prints the ten most frequent words with their counts. It uses the first command-line argument as the file path, or defaults to `data/sample.txt` if none is provided. It is useful for simple word-frequency summaries, but it does not handle punctuation or non-space separators specially.
